text: In September 2015 our record converged on one object. Seventy-one of us said "defund planned parenthood," a phrase Ted Cruz first entered on 2015-07-14; it peaked on 2015-09-18. Sixty-eight of us said "planned parenthood act," and sixty-five "defund planned parenthood act," all cresting the same day. Sixty-four of us carried "the defund planned parenthood," sixty-two "the defund planned parenthood act." Alongside this, sixty of us said "the iran nuclear," first entered on 2013-11-08 by Michael T. McCaul. Later in the month fifty-one of us said "survivors protection act" and fifty "abortion survivors protection act," both first entered on 2015-09-14 by Gary J. Palmer, both peaking on 2015-09-18. We record that our highest counts fell on a single day, 2015-09-18, and that our most-repeated words named one institution. We report this as it stands.
